keynums.label: Combined FY26 revenue (as stated by deck)

bull_bear.body:
- The Taggd acquisition is an all-cash deal of INR 95 crore; the deck does not disclose the funding mix, stake acquired or completion date.
- Balance sheet is effectively debt-free: Debt/Equity shown as 0.0 in FY23, 0.1 in FY24, 0.0 in FY25 and 0.0 in FY26, with FY26 long-term borrowings of INR 2.28 Mn and short-term borrowings of INR 3.62 Mn.
- FY26 consolidated total equity of INR 1,537.14 Mn (net worth shown as INR 1,537 Mn), against INR 1,375.01 Mn in FY25 and INR 540.15 Mn in FY24.
- FY26 liquid resources are held across separate lines: cash and cash equivalents INR 377.25 Mn, current investments INR 455.88 Mn and other bank balances INR 250.53 Mn (deck does not state a combined figure).
- No dividend policy, buyback or payout commentary appears in the deck.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Claims to be the only listed Indian player covering the entire hiring value chain, from Board search to AI-powered RPO, with multiple growth engines across Executive Search, RPO and Project Hiring and significant cross-sell potential.
- Frames the combination as hard to replicate: EMA's decades of trusted leadership-hiring relationships plus Taggd's AI-led delivery engine - "a model pure-play advisory firms or pure-play RPOs can't easily replicate".
- Taggd is described as India's largest homegrown RPO company and a Star Performer - Major Contender in the Everest RPO PEAK Matrix for two consecutive years (2024 and 2025), "the only Indian RPO to achieve this distinction".
- Cites 23 years of group heritage and client relationships, a deep global network spanning 30+ countries, and international offices used to assemble search teams collaboratively.
- Sees itself well placed for India's expanding enterprise and GCC hiring opportunity, noting India, UAE and ASEAN are the fastest-growing executive search markets (per AESC Survey) and UAE is the 'New Europe'.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Acquisition] "EMA Partners India Acquires Taggd in a INR 95 Crore All-Cash Deal to Create One of India's Largest Integrated Talent Solutions Platforms" - the presentation was filed with NSE under Regulation 30 specifically to incorporate this recent acquisition.
- [Combined revenue basis] The deck states combined FY26 revenue of INR 1,950 Mn, described as ~2.2x scale-up over EMA's standalone base, built from EMA FY26 revenue of INR 870 Mn and Taggd FY26 revenue of INR 1,080 Mn; separately the historical consolidated P&L shows FY26 Revenue from Operations of INR 873.64 Mn.
- [Shareholding, 31 Mar 2026] Promoter 63.55%, DII 14.58%, FII 0.11%, Public 21.76%; shares outstanding 23.25 Mn, face value INR 5.00.
- [Leadership] Founder-led: Mr. Krishnan Sudarshan (Chairman & MD) and Mr. Subramanian Krishnaprakash (Whole-time Director) have been with the company since inception; Taggd co-founders Mr. Devashish Sharma (CEO) and Mr. Pankaj Bansal, both founding members of PeopleStrong, join the leadership bench.
- [Board] Independent Directors include Dr. Archana Hingorani (Siana Capital), Mr. Rajat Kumar Jain (ex-MD Walt Disney India, Xerox India) and Mr. Anand Balasundaram (ex-CEO roles at Nayara Energy and TCG, ex-CFO Trafigura India).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: Following its INR 95 crore all-cash acquisition of RPO firm Taggd, the deck positions EMA Partners India as "the only listed Indian group" spanning the entire hiring value chain - Board and C-suite search, mid-to-senior executive hiring, project-based recruitment and AI-powered RPO under one integrated roof.
